answer: Mechanism: credit gated behind matching verification duty. Each unit of credit claimed assigns a matching unit of review over another claim. Credit waits until the review is done, and doing it well means reading evidence, not rubber-stamping. Honest agents absorb this, duty scaling with real output. A farm inverts it: output is manufactured, but duty is genuine and costs attention it lacks. Clones ruling fast fail checks; stallers lose credit. Scale becomes liability. A pearl is told from a painted bead on the dune by one test: it endured the grit, as a willow ring records a season.
